name: aforge
description: Low-code AI studio: wireframes + user stories → blocks → Claude Code / Codex implementation → isolated container preview and tests

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @aforge/server" "npm run dev -w @aforge/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p packages/runner && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/relay && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.keycloak: docker run --rm --name aforge-keycloak -p 8380:8080 -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME=kcadmin -e KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=kcadmin -v "$PWD/deploy/keycloak:/opt/keycloak/data/import:ro" quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.5.2 start-dev --import-realm
